DEPARTMENT OF PATHOLOGY

Pap Smear Examination: Cervical.

             

                                                             

    1] Specimen Adequacy – Satisfactory / Unsatisfactory.

                                         

    2] Cellular morphology

       

        A] Superficial cells   ++

        B] Intermediate cells   +

        C] Parabasal cells - A few

        D] Metaplastic Squamous cells - Nil

        E] Endocervical cells   +

        F] Others - x

  

    3] Inflammation:     Severe  /   Mild     /      Moderate         

 

    4] Organisms:   

        a] Trichomonas Vaginalis – Not found.

 

        b] Candida Albicans – Not found.

 

        c] Fungal organisms – Not found.

                               

        d] Others – Not found.

 

   5] Epithelial cells abnormalities: Atypical Squamous / Glandular cells not detected.

         

 

    Interpretation of Results: Negative for Intraepithelial lesion or malignancy. Acute cervicitis.

                                                       

   Note: Cervical cytology is a screening test and has associated false negative and false Positive  

              Results. Regular Sampling and follow up is recommended.

        

   ENCLOSED    :        One Slide (PAP).

                                    (SDC/SM/00/24)

 

   5] Epithelial cells abnormalities:  1) Atypical Squamous cells – A few.

                                                          2) No abnormal glandular cells not detected.

         

    Interpretation of Results: Negative for Intraepithelial lesion or malignancy.

                                                   Acute cervicitis with mild dysplasia.

 NB:   If any ulcerative lesion persists after treatment, excision cervical biopsy is recommended.

TEST REQUESTED             :     Cervical smear for Pap stain.                            

 

 

MICROSCOPIC FINDINGS    :    Smears show absence of malignant epithelial cells.

 

 

   Maturation Index        :    Parabasal           Intermediate          Superficial

                                                            

                                                            03 %                     37 %                      60 %

                                                       

 

Inflammatory cells / Infection :    Plenty of neutrophils (Severe type).

                                                        

                                                     [1] Candida albicans – Not found.

                                                     

                                                     [2] Fungal bodies – Not found. 

                                                           

                                                   Atypical squamous/glandular epithelial cells – Not found.

                                       

 

                                       REMARK : Acute cervicitis.

                                                        Negative for Intraepithelial lesion/Malignancy.   

                                                     

                                                        Please correlate clinically.

 

   ENCLOSED                          :    Two Slides.

                                                    (SDC/SM/ 114/24)

DEPARTMENT OF PATHOLOGY

 

Inflammatory smear (Reactive)

 

Cervical smear for PAP Stain

------------------------------------------------

I ) SPECIMEN TYPE :  Conventional pap smear.

II) SPECIMEN ADEQUACY : Adequate for evaluation with presence of endocervical                                                                                                                            

                                            cells and metaplastic squamous cells. 

III)  MICROSCOPY :

  1. Cellularity : Superficial, intermediate, few parabasal cells and metaplastic                       

                    squamous cells are present. Endocervical cells are also seen.                        

  1. Non neoplastic findings : Reactive cellular changes. (Dense polymorphs present)
  2. Specific Infection :  Nil.
  3. Negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy.

 

IMPRESSION : Inflammatory smear (Reactive cellular changes)

ADVICE : Follow up.

Note :  It is a screening test. As with screening tests, false positive and false negative result are seen. Positive screening test requires biopsy and other ancillary tests for confirmation.

 

 ENCLOSED         :    Two Slides. (PAP stain C & EC)

                                    (SDC/SM/00/24)

------------------------------------------------

III)Microscopy :

2. Non neoplastic findings : Dense polymorphs present.

                           (Reactive cellular changes).

 

3.SPECIFIC INFECTION : Nil

 

4. Negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy.

 

IMPRESSION : Inflammatory atrophic smear.

      (Reactive cellular changes)

 

ADVICE : Follow-up.

 

 

Note: It is a screening test. As with screening tests, false positive & false negative results are seen. Positive screening test requires biopsy and other ancillary tests for confirmation.

 

 

ENCLOSED         :    Two Slides. (PAP stain C & EC)

                                    (SDC/SM/00/24)

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 


DEPARTMENT OF PATHOLOGY

 

 

Inflammatory Atrophic with LSIL

 

Cervical smear for PAP Stain

------------------------------------------------

 

I) SPECIMEN TYPE : Conventional  pap smear with presence of endocervical    

                                 cells/transformation zone.

 

II) SPECIMEN ADEQUACY: Satisfactory for evaluation.

 

III) MICROSCOPY :

 

1. Cellularity : Parabasal cells, intermediate cells and sheets alongwith disperse  

                        population of slightly atypical squamous cells. There is anisonucleosis           

                        with slightly increased nucleo-cytoplasmic ratio. Metaplastic squamous   

                        cells are also present.

 

2. Non neoplastic findings : Dense neutrophilic infiltration.

 

 

3.Specific Infection : Negative

 

 

4. Epithelial Cell Abnormality (Squamous): Low grade squamous intraepithelial

                                                                      lesion (LSIL).

 

5.Epithelial Cell Abnormality (Glandular):  Negative

 

IMPRESSION : Inflammatory atrophic smears with low grade Squamous

                       intra-epithelial lesion (LSIL).

 

ADVICE : (i) Repeat smear after control of infection.

              (ii) Close follow-up.

 

Note: It is a screening test. As with screening tests, false positive & false negative results are seen. Positive screening test requires biopsy and other

ancillary tests for confirmation.

 

ENCLOSED         :  Two Slides. (PAP stain C & EC)                                   

                                 (SDC/SM/00/24)

                         Population of intermediate cells with high nucleo-cytoplasmic ratio.

4.Epithelial Cell Abnormality : (Squamous)Low grade squamous intraepithelial

                                                   lesion (LSIL).

 

5.Epithelial Cell Abnormality (Glandular):  Negative

 

IMPRESSION : Low grade Squamous intra-epithelial Lesion (LSIL).

 

 ADVICE : Follow-up.

 

Note: It is a screening test. As with screening tests, false positive & false negative results are seen. Positive screening test requires biopsy and other ancillary tests for confirmation.

DEPARTMENT OF PATHOLOGY

 

(Atrophic smear with LSIL)

 

Cervical smear for PAP Stain

------------------------------------------------

 

I) SPECIMEN TYPE : Conventional pap smear.

 

II) SPECIMEN ADEQUACY: Adequate for evaluation.

 

III) MICROSCOPY :

 

1. Cellularity : Mostly parabasal cells alongwith few intermediate, superficial cells and

                        metaplastic squamous epithelial cells. Some squamous cells have high  

                        nucleo-cytoplasmic ratio.

 

2. Non Neoplastic Findings : Sparse neutrophilic infiltration.

 

3. Specific Infection : Nil

 

4. Epithelial Cell Abnormality (Squamous) : Low grade squamous intraepithelial lesion

                                                                       (LSIL).

 

5. Epithelial Cell Abnormality (Glandular):  Negative.

 

6. Endometrial Cells : Present

 

IMPRESSION : Atrophic smear with low grade squamous intraepithelial lesion                                     

                       (LSIL).

 

ADVICE : Follow-up

        

 Note: It is a screening test. As with screening tests, false positive & false negative   

 results are seen. Positive screening test requires biopsy and other ancillary tests

 for confirmation.

 

ENCLOSED         :  Two Slides. (PAP stain C & EC)                                   

                                  (SDC/SM/00/24)

 

 

 

 

 


DEPARTMENT OF PATHOLOGY

 

 

(Atrophic smear)

Cervical smear for PAP Stain

------------------------------------------------

 

I) SPECIMEN TYPE : Conventional pap smear.

 

II) SPECIMEN ADEQUACY:  Adequate for evaluation with presence of transformation 

                                            zone component.

 

III) MICROSCOPY :

 

1. Cellularity : Many parabasal cells along with few intermediate and superficial cells.

      Endocervical cells are also present.

               

2. Non neoplastic findings : Sparse polymorphs present.

 

3.Specific infection : Nil

 

4. Negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy.

 

IMPRESSION : Atrophic smear.

 

ADVICE : Follow-up.

 

Note: It is a screening test. As with screening tests, false positive & false negative results are seen. Positive screening test requires biopsy and other ancillary tests for confirmation.

 

ENCLOSED         :  Two Slides. (PAP stain C & EC)                                                                                     

                                 (SDC/SM/00/24)

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 


DEPARTMENT OF PATHOLOGY

 

(Squamous cells carcinoma)

 

Cervical smear for PAP Stain

------------------------------------------------

 

 

I)SPECIMEN TYPE : Conventional pap smear.

 

II) SPECIMEN ADEQUACY: Adequate for evaluation with endocervical/transformation

                                            zone absent

 

 

III) MICROSCOPY :

 

1. Cellularity : Pleomorphic squamous cells in sheets and in disperse manner. These

                         cells have hyperchromatic nuclei and high nucleo-cytoplasmic ratio.    

                         Dyskaryotic cells are also noted.

 

2. Non neoplastic findings : Tumor diathesis present.

 

 

3. Specific infection : Nil 

 

 

4. Epithelial cell abnormality : (Squamous) Squamous cell carcinoma.

 

5. Epithelial cell abnormality (Glandular):  Nil

 

 

IMPRESSION : Squamous cell carcinoma.

 

         

ADVICE : Urgent surgical biopsy for confirmation.

 

Note: It is a screening test. As with screening tests, false positive & false negative results are seen. Positive screening test requires biopsy and other ancillary tests for confirmation.

 

 

ENCLOSED         :  Two Slides. (PAP stain C & EC)                                                                              

                                 (SDC/SM/00/24)

DEPARTMENT OF PATHOLOGY

 

 

(HSIL)

 

Cervical smear for PAP Stain

------------------------------------------------

 

 

I)SPECIMEN TYPE : Conventional pap smear.

 

II) SPECIMEN ADEQUACY: Adequate for evaluation.

 

 

III) MICROSCOPY :

 

1. Cellularity : Pleomorphic squamous cells in sheets and in disperse manner. These

                         cells have hyperchromatic nuclei and high nucleo-cytoplasmic ratio.    

                         Few superficial and intermediate cells are present.

 

2. Non neoplastic findings : Haemorrhagic and polymorphs.

 

 

3. Specific infection : Nil 

 

 

4. Epithelial cell abnormality (Squamous) : (Squamous) High grade squamous         

                                                                       intraepithelial lesion (HSIL).

 

5. Epithelial cell abnormality (Glandular):  Nil

 

 

IMPRESSION : High grade squamous intra-epithelial lesion (HSIL).

 

         

ADVICE : Urgent surgical biopsy to rule out invasive neoplasm.

 

Note: It is a screening test. As with screening tests, false positive & false negative results are seen. Positive screening test requires biopsy and other ancillary tests for confirmation.

 

 

ENCLOSED         :  Two Slides. (PAP stain C & EC)                                   

                                 (SDC/SM/00/24)

                                 cells/transformation zone.

 

II) SPECIMEN ADEQUACY: Satisfactory for evaluation.

 

III) MICROSCOPY :

DEPARTMENT OF PATHOLOGY

             

                                           

Cervical smear for PAP Stain

------------------------------------------------

  1] Specimen Adequacy : Satisfactory for evaluation with endocervical cells and            

                                          metaplastic squamous cells.                                                                                                                        

                                         

  2] Interpretation of Results :

      

        A] Superficial cells   ++

        B] Intermediate cells   +

        C] Parabasal cells - A few

        D] Metaplastic Squamous cells   ++

        E] Endocervical cells   +

        F] Others - x

  

   3] Inflammation: Severe 

 

   4] Organisms: NIL

 

   5] Epithelial cells abnormalities: Atypical Squamous cells of undetermined significance (ASC - US).

         

                         

                            

   IMPRESSION:  Atypical Squamous cells of undetermined significance (ASC - US).

 

 

   Note: Cervical cytology is a screening test and has associated false negative and false Positive  

              Results. Regular Sampling and follow up is recommended.

 

 

   ADVICE : A) Repeat smear after control of infection and follow up.

                     B) Surgical biopsy if clinical suspicion is high.

       

 

   ENCLOSED :  Two Slides. (PAP stain C & EC)

                           (SDC/AB/23/24)
